name: GenColor AI
summary: Turns a photo or a text prompt into printable coloring pages, on Basic, Plus and Studio monthly plans.
description: GenColor AI generates printable coloring pages from a photo or a text prompt, with PNG and PDF export. Two variations per generation are included on the listed plans.

pricing.details: Basic 9 €/month (180 generations, 360 pages, personal use); Plus 18 €/month (500 generations, 1,000 pages, background/watermark removal, batch and 4x upscale); Studio 44 €/month (1,500 generations, 3,000 pages, commercial rights). Limited-time official promo: 40% off annual, shown as 5 € / 11 € / 27 € per month equivalent.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Photo or text prompt to printable coloring pages
